What this is. A personal prototype exploring how agentic analytics could work for workforce data: a dashboard you pull, plus auto-written insights, natural-language Q&A and a proactive alert that finds you. Conceptually inspired by Tableau Pulse, Tableau Agent and Agentforce — this is my own lightweight take, not those products.
Privacy by design: data is fully synthetic and randomly generated. No individual records are displayed, and any group smaller than 5 people is suppressed to prevent re-identification.
